{{nihongo|'''Hananagashimo Shrine'''|花長下神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

'''Hananagashimo Shrine''' (はなながしもじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Ibigawa|Q1204046|qid=Q1204046}} (former {{ill|Tanigumi, Gifu|Q7683297|qid=Q7683297}}), {{ill|Ibi District, Gifu|Q1204309|qid=Q1204309}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}.

It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} (Hananagashimo Shrine, {{ill|Ōno district|Q11439757|qid=Q11439757|lt=Ōno District}}, {{ill|Mino Province|Q864156|qid=Q864156|lt=Mino}}), and its former {{ill|Q712534|lt=rank}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}.

=== Outline ===
*The time of initial enshrinement is unknown.
*It has a close relationship with {{ill|Hananagakami Shrine|ja|花長上神社|qid=Q11615716}}, also in former Tanigumi Village. Akafusuma Inuo Ōsumi Hiko Sawake-no-Mikoto (deity of Hananagashimo Shrine) and {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Amenomikatsuhime-no-Mikoto}} (deity of Hananagakami Shrine) are deities in {{ill|Izumo Province|Q582846|qid=Q582846|lt=Izumo myths}} described in the ''{{ill|Izumo-no-Kuni Fudoki|Q11395858|qid=Q11395858}}''; Hananagashimo Shrine is considered male deity and Hananagakami Shrine female deity (there is also a theory they are a married pair). Also, the September 7 festival is held alternately by Hananagashimo Shrine and Hananagakami Shrine.
*The precincts are a habitat of {{ill|Euterpnosia chibensis|ceb|Euterpnosia chibensis|ja|ヒメハルゼミ|qid=Q5976326}}, and are designated a natural monument by Gifu Prefecture<ref>{{Cite web|和書|date= |url=http://www.pref.gifu.lg.jp/kyoiku-bunka-sports/bunka-geijutsu/bunkazai-zuroku/bunkazai-zuroku/tenki/ibigawachou/himeharuzemi.html |title=ヒメハルゼミ生息地 |publisher=Gifu Prefecture |accessdate=2012-10-17}}</ref>.

=== Enshrined deity ===
*Akafusuma Inuo Ōsumi Hiko Sawake-no-Mikoto
:A deity of {{ill|Izumo Province|Q582846|qid=Q582846|lt=Izumo myths}}. Also written as Akafusuma Inuo Ōsumi Hiko Sawake-no-Mikoto. It appears in the ''Izumo-no-Kuni Fudoki'' in Inuo-go of {{ill|Aika district|ja|秋鹿郡|zh|秋鹿郡|qid=Q11595889}} and Inu-go of {{ill|Izumo district|Q10896679|qid=Q10896679}}, and is said to be a child of {{ill|Omizunu|ja|淤美豆奴神|zh|淤美豆奴神|qid=Q48745416|lt=Yatsukamizu Omitsuno-no-Mikoto}}, though details are unknown. It is enshrined at {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Inu Shrine}} in {{ill|Izumo, Shimane|Q825166|qid=Q825166}}, {{ill|Shimane Prefecture|Q132751|qid=Q132751}}.

=== Location ===
*Tanigumi Narei 848, Ibigawa, Ibi District, Gifu Prefecture

=== Transportation ===
*About 5 km from {{ill|Tanigumiguchi Station|Q7683296|qid=Q7683296}} on the {{ill|Tarumi Railway|Q11543718|qid=Q11543718}}.

=== Other ===
*Alternative readings for Hananagashimo Shrine include “Hanaka-shimo-jinja” and “Hanashimo-jinja.” In ''Shikinaisha Chōsa Hōkoku'' (ed. Shikinaisha Research Society, Kōgakkan University Press), the reading is given as “Hananagashimo-jinja.”
